scripts.lint: npm --prefix codesentry-web run lint && node codesentry-web/node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js --config codesentry-web/eslint.config.mjs 'scripts/*.mjs' 'codesentry-web/scripts/*.mjs'
scripts.format:check: npm --prefix codesentry-web run format:check && node codesentry-web/node_modules/prettier/bin/prettier.cjs --config codesentry-web/.prettierrc.json --check 'scripts/*.mjs' 'codesentry-web/scripts/*.mjs' '.github/**/*.{yml,md}' package.json && mvn -q -f codesentry-server/pom.xml spotless:check
